d.ko: Battle for survival in the skies of a mysterious future Earth in this unique action-strategy game mixing arcade combat, exploration, management and diplomacy. As giant flying ships wage spectacular aerial warfare, a prophecy tells of one who will save the world – could it be you?

d.zh: 这个世界已经遗忘了它的过去。为了夺回失去的一切，萨亚迪家族将千吨巨舰送上天空，这片土地也不再宁静。
